analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 trading sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and entered the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram has turned positive from negative, showing improvement. The 5-day low ($546.30) is higher than the 20-day low ($537.27), forming a Higher Low pattern, indicating a recovery signal. However, the weekly ADX is 13.5, indicating a non-trending, choppy market, requiring further confirmation.
